records.context: Yield reads together with the barcodes found inside them.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.iter_annotated_reads#0
records.source: Yield reads together with the barcodes found inside them.
records.translation: 리드를 그 안에서 찾은 바코드와 함께 생성합니다.

records.context: Search for barcodes a chunk at a time, reporting after every chunk.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.iter_barcode_search#0
records.source: Search for barcodes a chunk at a time, reporting after every chunk.
records.translation: 청크 단위로 바코드를 검색하며, 청크마다 보고합니다.

records.context: Yield read sequences from a sequencing file without loading it.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.iter_fastq_reads#0
records.source: Yield read sequences from a sequencing file without loading it.
records.translation: 시퀀싱 파일을 메모리에 불러오지 않고 리드 서열을 생성합니다.

records.context: Read a reference table of barcodes from a comma separated file.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.load_barcode_table#0
records.source: Read a reference table of barcodes from a comma separated file.
records.translation: 쉼표로 구분된 파일에서 바코드 참조 테이블을 읽습니다.

records.context: Read several reference tables at once.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.load_barcode_tables#0
records.source: Read several reference tables at once.
records.translation: 여러 참조 테이블을 한 번에 읽습니다.

records.context: Turn a finished search into settings for a barcode mapping run.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.propose_map_barcodes_settings#0
records.source: Turn a finished search into settings for a barcode mapping run.
records.translation: 완료된 검색을 바코드 매핑 실행용 설정으로 바꿉니다.

records.context: Return the reverse complement of a nucleotide sequence.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.reverse_complement#0
records.source: Return the reverse complement of a nucleotide sequence.
records.translation: 뉴클레오타이드 서열의 역상보 서열을 반환합니다.

records.context: Read a bounded sample of sequences from a sequencing file.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.sample_fastq_reads#0
records.source: Read a bounded sample of sequences from a sequencing file.
records.translation: 시퀀싱 파일에서 크기가 제한된 서열 샘플을 읽습니다.

records.context: Search a bounded sample of reads and return the finished report.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search.search_barcodes#0
records.source: Search a bounded sample of reads and return the finished report.
records.translation: 크기가 제한된 리드 샘플을 검색하고 완성된 보고서를 반환합니다.

records.context: Store a selected baseline and its reporting sentence.
records.label: spacr.baseline.Baseline#0
records.source: Store a selected baseline and its reporting sentence.
records.translation: 선택한 기준선과 그 보고 문장을 저장합니다.

records.context: Return whether applying the baseline changes effect values.
records.label: spacr.baseline.Baseline.moves#0
records.source: Return whether applying the baseline changes effect values.
records.translation: 기준선을 적용하면 효과 값이 바뀌는지 반환합니다.

records.context: ``frame`` with every effect re-expressed against ``baseline``.
records.label: spacr.baseline.apply#0
records.source: ``frame`` with every effect re-expressed against ``baseline``.
records.translation: ``frame``의 모든 효과를 ``baseline`` 기준으로 다시 표현한 것입니다.

records.context: Return a one-sentence description of the fitted intercept.
records.label: spacr.baseline.describe_intercept#0
records.source: Return a one-sentence description of the fitted intercept.
records.translation: 적합된 절편을 한 문장으로 설명하여 반환합니다.

records.context: Resolve the baseline used to report effects.
records.label: spacr.baseline.resolve#0
records.source: Resolve the baseline used to report effects.
records.translation: 효과를 보고하는 데 사용할 기준선을 확인합니다.

records.context: One ``spacr-run`` invocation, with its place in the work list's history.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job#0
records.source: One ``spacr-run`` invocation, with its place in the queue's history.
records.translation: ``spacr-run`` 호출 하나와 대기열 이력에서의 위치입니다.

records.context: Return a fresh, never-run copy of this job with ``changes`` applied.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.copy#0
records.source: Return a fresh, never-run copy of this job with ``changes`` applied.
records.translation: ``changes``를 적용한, 한 번도 실행되지 않은 이 작업의 새 사본을 반환합니다.

records.context: A readable label derived from the module and its ``src``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.default_label#0
records.source: A readable label derived from the module and its ``src``.
records.translation: 모듈과 그 ``src``에서 도출한 읽기 쉬운 레이블입니다.

records.context: Wall-clock seconds the job took, or None if it never finished.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.duration_s#0
records.source: Wall-clock seconds the job took, or None if it never finished.
records.translation: 작업에 걸린 실제 경과 시간(초)이며, 완료되지 않았으면 None입니다.

records.context: Seconds the job has taken, counting up while it is still executing.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.elapsed_s#0
records.source: Seconds the job has taken, counting up while it is still running.
records.translation: 작업에 걸린 시간(초)이며, 실행 중에는 계속 증가합니다.

records.context: Rebuild a job from :meth:`to_dict`, tolerating a hand-edited file.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.from_dict#0
records.source: Rebuild a job from :meth:`to_dict`, tolerating a hand-edited file.
records.translation: :meth:`to_dict`로부터 작업을 다시 만들며, 직접 편집한 파일도 허용합니다.

records.context: True when the job exited 0 but its own ledger says items failed.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.is_partial#0
records.source: True when the job exited 0 but its own ledger says items failed.
records.translation: 작업이 0으로 종료했지만 자체 원장에 실패한 항목이 있으면 True입니다.

records.context: ``overrides`` normalised to the ``key=value`` strings ``--set`` takes.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.override_args#0
records.source: ``overrides`` normalised to the ``key=value`` strings ``--set`` takes.
records.translation: ``overrides``를 ``key=value`` 문자열로 정규화한 것으로, ``--set``이 받는 형식입니다.

records.context: Clear the bookkeeping so the job can execute again. Returns ``self``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.reset#0
records.source: Clear the bookkeeping so the job can run again. Returns ``self``.
records.translation: 작업을 다시 실행할 수 있도록 기록 정보를 지웁니다. ``self``를 반환합니다.

records.context: The settings file path, or ``''`` when the job carries a key-value mapping.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.settings_path#0
records.source: The settings file path, or ``''`` when the job carries a dict.
records.translation: 설정 파일 경로이며, 작업이 사전을 담고 있으면 ``''``입니다.

records.context: Return the job as a JSON-serialisable key-value mapping, in a stable structured-data name order.
records.label: spacr.batch.Job.to_dict#0
records.source: Return the job as a JSON-serialisable dict, in a stable key order.
records.translation: 작업을 안정적인 키 순서의 JSON 직렬화 가능한 사전으로 반환합니다.

records.context: One thing wrong with a job or with the software job list.
records.label: spacr.batch.Problem#0
records.source: One thing wrong with a job or with the queue.
records.translation: 작업이나 대기열에서 잘못된 점 하나입니다.

records.context: True when this problem must stop the work list from starting.
records.label: spacr.batch.Problem.is_error#0
records.source: True when this problem must stop the queue from starting.
records.translation: 이 문제 때문에 대기열을 시작하면 안 되는 경우 True입니다.

records.context: One incremental progress report, handed to ``on_progress``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Progress#0
records.source: One incremental progress report, handed to ``on_progress``.
records.translation: ``on_progress``에 전달되는 증분 진행 보고서 하나입니다.

records.context: An ordered list of :class:`Job`\ s, run one at a time, top to bottom.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue#0
records.source: An ordered list of :class:`Job`\ s, run one at a time, top to bottom.
records.translation: :class:`Job` 객체의 순서가 있는 목록으로, 위에서 아래로 한 번에 하나씩 실행합니다.

records.context: Validate ``job`` and append it to the work list.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.add#0
records.source: Validate ``job`` and append it to the queue.
records.translation: ``job``을 검증하고 대기열에 추가합니다.

records.context: Jobs per status, in :data:`ALL_STATUSES` order.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.counts#0
records.source: Jobs per status, in :data:`ALL_STATUSES` order.
records.translation: 상태별 작업 수이며, :data:`ALL_STATUSES` 순서를 따릅니다.

records.context: Return the job with ``job_id``, or None.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.find#0
records.source: Return the job with ``job_id``, or None.
records.translation: ``job_id``인 작업을 반환하며, 없으면 None을 반환합니다.

records.context: Rebuild a work list from :meth:`to_dict` or from a hand-written file.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.from_dict#0
records.source: Rebuild a queue from :meth:`to_dict` or from a hand-written file.
records.translation: :meth:`to_dict` 또는 직접 작성한 파일로부터 대기열을 다시 만듭니다.

records.context: Every job id, in processing-session order.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.ids#0
records.source: Every job id, in run order.
records.translation: 모든 작업 ID를 실행 순서대로 나열한 것입니다.

records.context: Position of ``job_id`` in run order, or ``-1``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.index#0
records.source: Position of ``job_id`` in run order, or ``-1``.
records.translation: 실행 순서에서 ``job_id``의 위치이며, 없으면 ``-1``입니다.

records.context: Return an unused, human-typable id for a job of ``module``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.mint_id#0
records.source: Return an unused, human-typable id for a job of ``module``.
records.translation: ``module`` 작업에 사용할, 사람이 입력하기 쉬운 미사용 ID를 반환합니다.

records.context: Move ``job_id`` ``offset`` places (negative is earlier).
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.move#0
records.source: Move ``job_id`` ``offset`` places (negative is earlier).
records.translation: ``job_id``를 ``offset``칸 이동합니다(음수면 앞으로).

records.context: Remove ``job_id`` and drop it from every other job's ``depends_on``.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.remove#0
records.source: Remove ``job_id`` and drop it from every other job's ``depends_on``.
records.translation: ``job_id``를 제거하고 다른 모든 작업의 ``depends_on``에서도 삭제합니다.

records.context: Clear every job's bookkeeping so the whole queue executes again.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.reset#0
records.source: Clear every job's bookkeeping so the whole queue runs again.
records.translation: 모든 작업의 기록 정보를 지워 대기열 전체를 다시 실행할 수 있게 합니다.

records.context: Return the whole work list as a JSON-serialisable key-value mapping.
records.label: spacr.batch.Queue.to_dict#0
records.source: Return the whole queue as a JSON-serialisable dict.
records.translation: 대기열 전체를 JSON 직렬화 가능한 사전으로 반환합니다.

records.context: The software job list itself is wrong — a bad job, a cycle, a refused start.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueError#0
records.source: The queue itself is wrong — a bad job, a cycle, a refused start.
records.translation: 대기열 자체가 잘못되었습니다 — 잘못된 작업, 순환, 거부된 시작.

records.context: Outcome of a software job list run: job states, timings and ledger.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult#0
records.source: Outcome of a queue run: job states, timings and ledger.
records.translation: 대기열 실행의 결과입니다: 작업 상태, 소요 시간 및 원장.

records.context: Wall-clock seconds the work list took.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.duration_s#0
records.source: Wall-clock seconds the queue took.
records.translation: 대기열에 걸린 실제 경과 시간(초)입니다.

records.context: Jobs that ran and failed.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.failed#0
records.source: Jobs that ran and failed.
records.translation: 실행되었지만 실패한 작업입니다.

records.context: Every job that ended in ``status``.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.jobs_with#0
records.source: Every job that ended in ``status``.
records.translation: ``status`` 상태로 끝난 모든 작업입니다.

records.context: Jobs the software job list halted before reaching.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.not_run#0
records.source: Jobs the queue halted before reaching.
records.translation: 대기열이 도달하기 전에 중단된 작업입니다.

records.context: True when everything ran, nothing failed and nothing is partial.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.ok#0
records.source: True when everything ran, nothing failed and nothing is partial.
records.translation: 모든 작업이 실행되었고, 실패한 것도 부분 완료된 것도 없으면 True입니다.

records.context: Jobs that exited 0 but whose own ledger recorded failed items.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.partial#0
records.source: Jobs that exited 0 but whose own ledger recorded failed items.
records.translation: 0으로 종료했지만 자체 원장에 실패한 항목이 기록된 작업입니다.

records.context: Jobs deliberately not executed because an upstream job did not succeed.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.skipped#0
records.source: Jobs deliberately not run because an upstream job did not succeed.
records.translation: 상위 작업이 성공하지 못해 의도적으로 실행하지 않은 작업입니다.

records.context: Jobs that exited 0 — including the ones that are only partial.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.succeeded#0
records.source: Jobs that exited 0 — including the ones that are only partial.
records.translation: 0으로 종료한 작업입니다 — 부분 완료에 그친 작업도 포함합니다.

records.context: Render the end-of-work list report.
records.label: spacr.batch.QueueResult.summary#0
records.source: Render the end-of-queue report.
records.translation: 대기열 종료 보고서를 렌더링합니다.

records.context: Turn an exit code plus a log into ``(kind, one-line message)``.
records.label: spacr.batch.classify_failure#0
records.source: Turn an exit code plus a log into ``(kind, one-line message)``.
records.translation: 종료 코드와 로그를 ``(kind, one-line message)``로 바꿉니다.

records.context: Format a duration in seconds as a short string.
records.label: spacr.batch.fmt_duration#0
records.source: Format a duration in seconds as a short string.
records.translation: 초 단위 소요 시간을 짧은 문자열로 형식화합니다.

records.context: Render every problem at once, errors first.
records.label: spacr.batch.format_problems#0
records.source: Render every problem at once, errors first.
records.translation: 모든 문제를 한꺼번에 렌더링하며, 오류를 먼저 표시합니다.

records.context: Execute one job in this interpreter, with its output tee'd to its log.
records.label: spacr.batch.inprocess_runner#0
records.source: Run one job in this interpreter, with its output tee'd to its log.
records.translation: 이 인터프리터에서 작업 하나를 실행하며, 출력은 로그에도 함께 기록합니다.

records.context: Return the exact ``spacr-run`` command line for ``job``.
records.label: spacr.batch.job_command#0
records.source: Return the exact ``spacr-run`` command line for ``job``.
records.translation: 정확한 ``spacr-run`` 명령줄을 ``job``에 대해 반환합니다.

records.context: Read a work list file written by :func:`save_queue`, or hand-written.
records.label: spacr.batch.load_queue#0
records.source: Read a queue file written by :func:`save_queue`, or hand-written.
records.translation: :func:`save_queue`가 기록했거나 직접 작성한 대기열 파일을 읽습니다.

records.context: Describe what the work list would do, without doing any of it.
records.label: spacr.batch.plan#0
records.source: Describe what the queue would do, without doing any of it.
records.translation: 대기열이 무엇을 할지 실제로 실행하지 않고 설명합니다.

records.context: Build the settings key-value mapping this job's module will actually receive.
records.label: spacr.batch.resolve_job_settings#0
records.source: Build the settings dict this job's module will actually receive.
records.translation: 이 작업의 모듈이 실제로 받을 설정 사전을 만듭니다.

records.context: Pick a work list up where a crash, a reboot or a Stop left it.
records.label: spacr.batch.resume_queue#0
records.source: Pick a queue up where a crash, a reboot or a Stop left it.
records.translation: 충돌, 재부팅 또는 Stop으로 멈춘 지점부터 대기열을 이어서 진행합니다.

records.context: Execute the software job list, one job at a time, and report on all of it.
records.label: spacr.batch.run_queue#0
records.source: Run the queue, one job at a time, and report on all of it.
records.translation: 대기열을 작업 하나씩 실행하고 전체 결과를 보고합니다.

records.context: Write ``queue`` to ``path`` atomically, as indented JSON.
records.label: spacr.batch.save_queue#0
records.source: Write ``queue`` to ``path`` atomically, as indented JSON.
records.translation: ``queue``를 ``path``에 들여쓰기된 JSON으로 원자적으로 기록합니다.

records.context: Execute one job as its own ``spacr-run`` process. **The default runner.**
records.label: spacr.batch.subprocess_runner#0
records.source: Run one job as its own ``spacr-run`` process. **The default runner.**
records.translation: 작업 하나를 별도의 ``spacr-run`` 프로세스로 실행합니다. **기본 실행기입니다.**

records.context: Check one job the way ``spacr-run --dry-run`` would, plus software job list rules.
records.label: spacr.batch.validate_job#0
records.source: Check one job the way ``spacr-run --dry-run`` would, plus queue rules.
records.translation: ``spacr-run --dry-run``과 같은 방식으로 작업 하나를 확인하고, 대기열 규칙도 확인합니다.

records.context: Validate every job, and the software job list's own structure, all at once.
records.label: spacr.batch.validate_queue#0
records.source: Validate every job, and the queue's own structure, all at once.
records.translation: 모든 작업과 대기열 자체의 구조를 한 번에 검증합니다.

records.context: Diagnostics for one correction operation.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.BatchCorrectionReport#0
records.source: Diagnostics for one correction operation.
records.translation: 보정 작업 하나에 대한 진단 정보입니다.

records.context: Return a JSON-serializable report.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.BatchCorrectionReport.to_dict#0
records.source: Return a JSON-serializable report.
records.translation: JSON 직렬화 가능한 보고서를 반환합니다.

records.context: Normalize numeric features within acquisition batches.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_batch_effects#0
records.source: Normalize numeric features within acquisition batches.
records.translation: 획득 배치 안에서 숫자 특징을 정규화합니다.

records.context: Correct a feature frame using named columns from an aligned metadata frame.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_from_metadata#0
records.source: Correct a feature frame using named columns from an aligned metadata frame.
records.translation: 정렬된 메타데이터 프레임의 지정된 열을 사용하여 특징 프레임을 보정합니다.

records.context: Translate shared GUI settings into correction-call keyword arguments.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correction_kwargs#0
records.source: Translate shared GUI settings into correction-call keyword arguments.
records.translation: 공유 GUI 설정을 보정 호출의 키워드 인수로 변환합니다.

records.context: Write a correction report as stable JSON and return its path.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.write_report#0
records.source: Write a correction report as stable JSON and return its path.
records.translation: 보정 보고서를 안정적인 JSON으로 기록하고 그 경로를 반환합니다.

records.context: Item count, wall time and peak memory observed in one benchmark run.
records.label: spacr.benchmark.Measurement#0
records.source: Item count, wall time and peak memory observed in one benchmark run.
records.translation: 벤치마크 실행 한 번에서 관측된 항목 수, 실제 경과 시간 및 최대 메모리입니다.

records.context: Return measured throughput, or NaN for a nonpositive duration.
records.label: spacr.benchmark.Measurement.items_per_second#0
records.source: Return measured throughput, or NaN for a nonpositive duration.
records.translation: 측정된 처리량을 반환하며, 소요 시간이 양수가 아니면 NaN을 반환합니다.

records.context: Return mean wall time per measured item, or NaN when none ran.
